antithesis: Prolonged exposure at 670nm may decrease mitochondrial biogenesis and generate oxidative stress in satellite_cell if irradiance exceeds optimal threshold. Paper (2024) notes dose-dependent tissue response.
synthesis: Apply Transcranial 870nm: neuron-specific at 345 THz, low irradiance 22.2 mW/cm^2, 40min targeting cytochrome_c in satellite_cell. Study reference: 2024 peer-reviewed paper shows electron transport +12% at 670nm. Dual-phase protocol minimizes off-target thermal effects while maximizing mitochondrial citrate_synthase activation.
